   - Behavior: how it sets the active workspace (localStorage, API call, router.refresh, etc.)

4. **Single-workspace behavior:** If a user has only ONE workspace, does the switcher still render (static pill showing the name)? Or is it hidden? Or does it become the app brand?

5. **Screenshot-in-words:** One paragraph describing exactly what the top-left/top-center of Rankora looks like to a user with 2+ workspaces. Include text labels used.

6. **Dependencies:** List the UI primitives used (shadcn dropdown? popover? command? Radix?) so I know what's portable to InkOS (which is on shadcn + Tailwind 4).

Do not propose InkOS changes. Just describe Rankora's pattern faithfully.

Since this is read-only, I'll provide my findings directly: ## Rankora Workspace Switcher Documentation ### 1. **Switcher Component Location** **File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx` **Component Name:** `WorkspaceSwitcher` Supporting files: - Hook: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/hooks/useWorkspace.tsx` (defines workspace data + active detection) - Used in: `AppHeader.tsx` (header variant), sidebars (default variant) --- ### 2. **Top-Bar Integration in AppHeader** **File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/AppHeader.tsx` (lines 139–145) **JSX Block:** ```jsx
{user ? ( <> {/* Account menu (initials) */} ) : ( {/* Sign in/up buttons */} )}
``` **Layout:** - **Header height:** 14 (`h-14`) - **Left of switcher:** SidebarTrigger (7×7, -ml-1.5) + vertical separator (h-4) + breadcrumb (Dashboard / Page Label) - **Right of switcher:** vertical separator (h-4 mx-1) → NotificationBell → account dropdown (initials in 9×9 blue pill) - **Wrapper:** `flex items-center justify-between h-14 gap-4` with px-6 to px-10 horizontal padding The header uses `border-b` to separate from content below. --- ### 3. **Switcher Component Anatomy** **File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx` **Trigger Visual (Header Variant):** - Icon square: 5×5 (h-5 w-5) with tinted bg, colored icon (3×3) - Workspace name text: semibold, 12.5px - Chevron (ChevronsUpDown): 3.5×3.5, muted-foreground/60 - Layout: icon + gap-2 + name + chevron - No border; inherits header bg; hover: bg-muted/60 - Height: 8 (h-8); padding: px-2 **Dropdown Menu Contents:** ``` ├─ Label: "WORKSPACES" (10.5px, uppercase, tracking-[0.08em], muted-foreground/70) ├─ [Workspace Item 1] │ ├─ Icon square: 7×7, tinted, rounded-md │ ├─ Label (13px semibold) + subtitle (11px, muted-foreground, 2-line clamp) │ ├─ Checkmark (4×4 primary) if active [right-aligned, mt-1.5] │ └─ Highlight bg: bg-sidebar-accent/60 when active ├─ [Workspace Item 2] (same as above) ├─ Separator └─ [Disabled item]: "More workspaces coming soon" (11.5px, muted-foreground/70) ``` **Dropdown styling:** - Width: 240px (w-[240px]) - Padding: p-1 (tight) - Menu items: px-2 py-2, rounded-md, cursor-pointer, flex gap-2.5 - Alignment: align="start", sideOffset={6} **Active Workspace Mark:** Green checkmark (Check icon, h-4 w-4, text-primary) **Behavior - Workspace Switch:** - Hook `useWorkspace()` provides: `{ active, activeKey, workspaces, switchTo }` - On select: `switchTo(w.key as WorkspaceKey)` → calls `router.push(target.homePath)` - Active workspace derived from pathname: `/agency` → "agency", else → "hiring" - No localStorage; purely URL-based + Next.js router **Loading / Empty States:** - No explicit loading skeleton in the component - If only 1 workspace: still renders the pill (no conditional hide) - Empty workspaces array: would show only the label + disabled "coming soon" item --- ### 4. **Single-Workspace Behavior** **Rankora Always Renders the Switcher**, even with only 1 workspace. The `WORKSPACES` array is hardcoded to exactly 2 (Hiring + Agency Hub), so this scenario doesn't naturally occur in the current codebase. However, the component would: - Render the pill showing the single workspace's name + icon - Dropdown would list just that 1 item (+ separator + "coming soon") - User could still click, but `switchTo()` would no-op because of the guard: `if (!target || target.key === activeKey) return;` **In production:** There's no conditional to hide the switcher if workspaces.length === 1. It will always show. --- ### 5. **Screenshot-in-Words** **Top-left to top-right of Rankora (with 2+ workspaces):** A 14px-tall header bar spans the full width. On the left: a 7×7 menu button (hamburger icon, muted), then a subtle gray divider, then breadcrumb navigation in small gray text ("Dashboard" or "Dashboard / Settings"). On the right (dark side): a compact pill shows a small blue or purple icon square, the workspace name ("Hiring" or "Agency Hub") in semi-bold 12.5px text, and a small gray chevron-up-down. Hovering the pill slightly brightens it. Clicking opens a dropdown menu (240px wide) with the heading "WORKSPACES" in tiny uppercase gray text, then two rows: each row has a tinted icon, the workspace name (semibold), a subtitle below in smaller text, and a green checkmark (if active) on the right. A separator, then a disabled "More workspaces coming soon" line. The user's account button (a 9×9 blue pill with white initials) sits immediately to the right of a separator line. A bell icon (notifications) is between the switcher and the separator. --- ### 6. **Dependencies & UI Primitives** Rankora uses: | Dependency | Version | Used For | |---|---|---| | `@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu` | ^2.1.15 | Switcher dropdown (DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator) | | `lucide-react` | (not shown in grep, but imported: Briefcase, Building2, ChevronsUpDown, Check) | Workspace icons + chevron | | `tailwindcss` | (inferred; all styling is Tailwind classes) | Layout, spacing, colors (bg-blue-500/10, text-blue-600, etc.) | **No popover, no command/cmdk, no custom dropdown implementation.** Pure shadcn-wrapped Radix UI DropdownMenu primitive. --- ### 7. **Key Integration Points for InkOS Replication** 1. **Use variant prop** to switch between sidebar (full-width, collapses) and header (compact, auto-width). 2. **Derive active workspace from pathname** in a custom hook (mirroring `useWorkspace()`), not from Redux or state. 3. **Router-based navigation**: `router.push(homePath)` on workspace select. 4. **Workspace config:** Define a `WORKSPACES` array with key, label, subtitle, icon, homePath, avatarBg, avatarFg. 5. **Radix DropdownMenu** is already in InkOS (via shadcn), so this is fully portable. 6. **Tailwind 4 compatible:** All classes (bg-blue-500/10, text-sm, gap-2, etc.) are standard Tailwind. --- **Files to Reference in Rankora:** - `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/layout/WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx` — 170 lines, clean, well-commented - `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/hooks/useWorkspace.tsx` — 73 lines, pathname-based detection + router push - `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/AppHeader.tsx` — shows header integration (lines 139–145 and line 143)
